name: dashboard-offer-external-model-admin
title: Offer · External model
description: Continuous captured native usage and versioned provider price estimates, with capture limits and invoice unknowns. Bounded probe receipts and monthly statements remain separate evidence.

contract.title: External models · usage and price estimates

options.text: **Continuous metering records delivered native events.** Counts cover the current UTC month only from the capture start shown below; delivery is best effort, so this is not a complete provider statement. **USD is a conditional token estimate, not an invoice or consumer charge.** OpenAI/Anthropic use verified public Standard global prices with stated assumptions; NVIDIA's exact hosted **free prototype** has no charge. Commercial terms, tools, commitments, fees and invoice reconciliation need separate evidence. User/subscription identity does not establish a team.

options.text: **GPT-6 Luna:** Standard global rates are assumed. Input is priced as uncached except proven nonzero cache quantities; missing cache details are not proof of zero. Input above 272K uses the higher context band. **Claude Sonnet 5.5:** this OpenAI-compatible route does not support prompt caching; provider input/output counts use Standard global rates. **Reasoning is already part of output and is not added again.** Tool fees, region/tier adjustments and invoice credits are excluded. **NVIDIA:** the exact hosted prototype is documented free; production pricing, capacity and SLA are not established.
